title: A Jar of Grey Paste
subtitle: 发明创造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 发明创造（科学与技术·发明与创造）
meta: 主题语境：发明创造（科学与技术·发明与创造）　|　核心词汇：product　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 product 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My grandfather invented a ① product for cleaning typewriter keys, and for thirty-one years it was the only thing in the house that was never discussed. He made it in the shed, sold it from the back of a van, and called it a ② product of patience, which is not what you would print on a tin. The ③ finished product was a small jar of grey paste, and it worked extremely well.

What he had not expected was the ④ by-product. The paste removed ink so effectively that it also removed the letters themselves, and by 1974 he had a second jar, a second label and a business selling two ⑤ products where he had intended to sell one. He said this is how invention works: you do not get what you aimed at, you get what you made.

The paste was the ⑥ product of lye and fat, which he mixed in the shed and never measured, and which is the reason my mother was not allowed in there. She says the recipe came from a ⑦ farm product she knew as a girl in 1952 — sour milk, I think — and that the whole thing was really her mother's, and I believe her.

He worked out his profit as the ⑧ product of eleven jars and three pounds, and wrote it on the shed wall in pencil; it is the only piece of his arithmetic I have ever seen. He never patented the product, which is the sentence my father repeats most often, and which I have come to hear as a kind of love.

By 1981 the typewriter was going, and with it the product, the jar and the van. I have one jar left. It is a ⑨ product in the oldest sense — a thing made by hand, in a shed, by two people who never agreed — and it is, I now think, the ⑩ product of a marriage rather than an invention: the paste was hers, the labels were his, and neither of them ever said so.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 农产品；天然产物（farm products）
C. n. 结果；产物；结晶（the product of ...）
D. 固定搭配：by-product 副产品
E. 固定搭配：finished product 成品
F. n.【化】生成物；（反应的）产物
H. n. （手工的）制品；做出来的东西

items.q: a product for cleaning typewriter keys
called it a product of patience
The finished product was a small jar

answers.why: a product for doing 意为“用于做……的产品”，指清洁打字机键的那种制品。
the product of ... 意为“……的产物／结果”，他称它是耐心的产物。
the finished product 意为“成品”，成品是一小罐灰色糊状物。
by-product 意为“副产品”，指糊状物顺带把字键上的字也擦掉了这件事带来的第二种产品。
products 复数意为“产品”，他本来只想卖一种，结果卖起了两种。
the product of ... 此处指化学反应的生成物，糊状物是碱液和油脂反应所得。
a farm product 意为“农产品”，母亲说配方来自她小时候知道的一种农产品。
the product of ... 在数学中意为“……的积”，十一罐与三英镑的乘积。
a product 意为“手工做出来的东西”，指棚屋里手工制成的一罐糊状物。
the product of ... 意为“……的产物”，说它是那段婚姻的产物，而不是发明的产物。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 product 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: My grandfather invented a product for cleaning typewriter keys and sold it from the back of a van for thirty-one years.
He called it a product of patience, and the finished product was a small jar of grey paste.
The by-product was that the paste removed the letters as well as the ink, so he ended up selling two products.
The paste was the product of lye and fat, mixed in the shed and never measured.
He worked out his profit as the product of eleven jars and three pounds, in pencil on the shed wall.
The jar I have left is a product in the oldest sense, and really the product of a marriage rather than an invention.
